column5:
This is not a list of 'The Greatest,' but a map of my own emotional attachment to the art of cinema. Do not look at it from the perspective of the critical acclaim, but approach it as a purely selfish list of what mattered or resonated to me. Not in terms of technical brilliance, but because it arrived at the right moment in my life.

Yes, you'll find the works of the great directors who influenced my tastes in cinema, but also the nostalgic gems that refer to a certain time and place. Constantly evolving, this living document provides a record of the favorite movies I've ever seen.
